paper.title: Locality-Induced Hierarchical Backflow Wavefunctions for Correlated Fermions
paper.authors: Yu-Tong Zhou, Zheng-Wei Zhou, Wen-Yuan Liu

results.system_description: 16x16 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 224 electrons (112 up, 112 down), n_h = 0.125
results.variant: HB K = 2 backbone times a feed-forward network factor, N_det = 5, N_neuron = 100
results.source_location: Main text, paragraph introducing the residual hierarchical backflow (RHB)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the RHB state, a hierarchical backflow multiplied by a feed-forward neural network, on the 16 × 16 PBC lattice at n_h = 0.125 and U = 8.
results.notes: The same sentence quotes the VAFQMC energy -0.7544 for comparison; it is not an entry. N_det = 5 and N_neuron = 100 are the settings the End Matter adopts for all large-scale simulations. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
